youtube_description:
Available to purchase on July 22nd from https://www.themotusprojects.com/

Teaser trailer edited by Sam Sutherland.

After over a year of lockdowns & separation, the majority of Motus athletes got together during a brief period of lifted restrictions to tour the U.K., train & reconnect. With interviews self-shot in the winter lockdown & and edited by first-time feature-length editors Kelan Ryan, Max Barker & Sam Sutherland, S.O.L is a reflection of pushing through adversity & into the unknown through teamwork and a focus on the journey rather than the destination.
